Lich Survivors · round 40 · the tunnel, the inventory, the question

2026-10-02. The caves are set aside (kept in archive/the-walk, tag walk-round39).

He comes in down the final room's tunnel, seen by a second fixed camera, carrying all six objects. Where the room's camera can see him, it cuts in and the fight starts: the final room exactly as it was. Clicking an object in the inventory brings up the model viewer with its description and the question; yes, and it falls to the floor.

Run it

run.batstarts in the tunnel
WASD / hold left mousemove
click an object / 5–0the question; Y or Enter: yes, N or Esc: no (the view still turns and zooms)
Ilook at the objects (no question)
Tremove every power at once (testing)

Open

Each object's description is yours to write (the [ YOUR TEXT ] slot). A key pressed for an object already given up brings it back (testing only). LICH_ROOM=1 still starts in the room as before, unchanged to the digest.
